summary: fix(youtube): un-shadow the global --home flag in activities-list; honest refusal for bulk export; MCP store path mirrors the CLI's credential-scoped databank filename; document the yt_* analyst schema in SKILL/README; add live-matrix fixtures to 7 video commands. Re-applied the MCP schema-property-name sanitizer the regen dropped (12 illegal keys).
reason: Live command census (proofs/live-command-census.md) exposed: (F1) the API's deprecated `home` param registered as --home, shadowing the global workspace flag — any workspace user got 'Incompatible parameters: channelId, home' from the live API; (F2) export youtube walked /youtube/v3/activities filterless and died with raw HTTP 400; (F4) mcpDBPath hardcoded data.db while the CLI writes data-<credhash>.db, splitting CLI and MCP onto different databanks on fresh homes; (F3) SKILL/README documented zero databank tables so agents could not use the sql tool; (F5) 7 video commands had no pp:happy-args so the live matrix skipped their happy paths. (F6, found by post-install benchmark) The reprint regenerated cobratree/typemap.go without the July schema-key sanitizer, reintroducing 12 Anthropic-illegal property keys like 'videoId|url' that 400-fail a session's entire tool list; sanitizer re-applied verbatim from patch fix-mcp-schema-property-names.
validated_outcome: publish validate + re-minted phase5 acceptance after fixes; F1/F2/F4 re-verified with live API calls

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Generator must not register endpoint params whose flag name collides with a global persistent flag (rename or prefix them)
deferred_to_upstream.reason: F1 is a generator template bug; the local rename to --home-feed should be superseded by a machine-level collision check.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Export/sync should detect filter-required bulk endpoints at generation time and emit the refusal themselves
deferred_to_upstream.reason: F2's refusal is API-shape knowledge the generator already has in the spec.
